name: ofcp-demo
description: OFCP demo shop — root dev orchestration for the NestJS API (:4000) and Nuxt UI (:3000).

scripts.install:all: pnpm --dir api install && pnpm --dir ui install
scripts.dev: OFCP_SALESCHANNEL_API_KEY=${OFCP_SALESCHANNEL_API_KEY:-tds_sc_eshop_dev_key} OFCP_GATEWAY_URL=${OFCP_GATEWAY_URL:-https://ofcp-api-gateway.staging.tecsafe.de} concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,ui --prefix-colors blue,green "pnpm --dir api start:dev" "pnpm --dir ui dev --host"
scripts.build: pnpm --dir api build && pnpm --dir ui build
scripts.test: concurrently --names api,ui --prefix-colors blue,green "pnpm --dir api test" "pnpm --dir ui test"
